question: You take a EUR deposit on Monday, 13 February. Assuming there are no intervening bank holidays, what is the one-month maturity date?

question: What does “modified following business day convention” mean?

options.A: A convention whereby a transaction is dated the following business day, unless that day extends into the next month, in which case it is dated the preceding business day
options.B: A convention whereby a transaction is dated the following business day
options.C: A convention whereby a transaction is dated the preceding business day
options.D: A convention whereby a transaction is dated the next business day that corresponds to the same numerical day of the month as the preceding payment

community_answer: A. A convention whereby a transaction is dated the following business day, unless that day extends into the next month, in which case it is dated the preceding business day

question: What does ISDA stand for?
community_answer: A. International Swaps and Derivatives Association

question: What is volatility?

options.A: The difference between the current price of an asset and its previous close
options.B: A statistical measure of price fluctuations as an annualized percentage
options.C: The measure of the liquidity of a contract or security
options.D: The difference between the annual high and low of a security

community_answer: B. A statistical measure of price fluctuations as an annualized percentage

question: In the unexpected event that a public holiday is declared on the date a particular contract matures, what is the normal market practice?

options.A: If that day is not the final trading day of the month, all contracts maturing on that day are extended to the next business day
options.B: If that day is not the final trading day of the month, all contracts maturing on that day are shortened to the preceding business day
options.C: All new maturity dates have to be agreed upon with the counterparties involved
options.D: Decisions about the maturity dates of trading contracts are made by ACIs Committee for Professionalism on a case-by-case basis and must be adhered to

community_answer: A. If that day is not the final trading day of the month, all contracts maturing on that day are extended to the next business day
